_note: The crab every player steers, its shell in the player's colour (SECOND-ORDER R1.90). Anatomy of a green or blue shore crab, checked from above, the side, the front and 3/4: a carapace wider than long (476 mm across the teeth, 452 behind them, 361 long), widest across its front third just behind the eyes, five teeth on each front-side margin, tapering to a narrower back edge, gently domed; two eyes on short stalks in notches at the front middle, short antennae between them; two claws from the front corners under the shell, each an arm (merus), a wrist (carpus) and a big palm (propodus) with a fixed finger below and a movable finger (dactyl) hinged on top, held in front of the face; four pairs of walking legs from under the sides, splayed sideways, each rising from under the margin to a high knee above the shell and angling down to a pointed tip, bending in the plane across the body, the back pair swept back; the abdomen a broad rounded flap folded flat under the body, one tile (200 mm) wide. Parts: body; eye_l, eye_r; claw_l_arm, claw_l_wrist, claw_l_palm, claw_l_finger and claw_r_...; leg_l1_hip, leg_l1_knee, leg_l1_foot for left legs 1 (front) to 4 (back) and leg_r1_... on the right, each named after the joint it turns about (hip: coxa and merus up to the knee; knee: carpus and propodus down to the ankle; foot: the dactyl). Anchors claw_left and claw_right: the middle of a held tile's underside, the tile's near edge between the open fingers (a 45 mm gap at rest). The walks go toward +x (walk_side) and +z (walk_fwd); played backwards they go the other way. The jump is the crab's pose only; the game lifts it. Written by tools/models/crab.py.
name: Crab
